run_model_server: run a postman model inference server on a given port with configurable batch size
run_server_with_port_queue: run the model server and send the bound port to a parent process via a queue
server_handler_load_and_eval: load a model via a function and serve batched evaluation requests in a loop
server_handler_with_ckpt_sync: run the server handler with periodic checkpoint syncing from a specified path
server_handler_with_transforms: run the server handler with custom input and output transform functions applied to batches
